title: The products over Y and Z in the common interchange grid
statement: For two diagrams d1,d2 of f:X to Y and g:Y to Z [def-pur-etale-graph-interchange-data], let F,G,H be the pairwise product presentations [lem-pur-etale-pairwise-product-graph-normalization] of their source, middle and composite presentations. Let V0 be V1 times_Z V2. The product maps E:H.U to V0 and K:V0 to H.P are open; R:V0 to G.U and P:H.P to G.P are proper; (K,R,P,G.e) commutes, E K=H.e and P G.p=H.p. Since g is open then proper it is separated. The maps BV:F.P to V0 and BW:F.U to H.U, formed by imposing equality over Y, are proper. They obey F.a BW=H.a, BV R=F.p G.a, and (F.e,BW,BV,E) commutes.

proof.text: Construct the four product maps by pullback.map over the identity of Z. Stability under base change and composition gives their properness and openness. Both projections establish the square equation and the open and proper factorization equations.

proof.text: The equation g=i1 q1 proves g separated. Define BV and BW by pullback.lift on the two projections. They are identified projectionwise with pullback.mapDesc followed by pullback.congrHom; the mapDesc maps are base changes of the closed diagonal of g, hence proper. Both projections prove the graph and square equations.
